site.name: Oscar, padel coach
site.description: Oscar is a padel coach and personal trainer with 10+ years of coaching experience. Message him on Instagram.

coach.surname_note: Not shown until Oscar confirms his full name for the site.
coach.tagline_source: The line on his public Instagram profile.

offers.title: Padel performance
offers.text: Training for how you move and perform on court.

contact.text: For now, message Oscar on Instagram. There is no online booking, no prices and no timetable on this site yet.

photos.alt: Oscar in a gym, in a lunge stretch, wearing a light blue training top.
photos.credit: Photo from Oscar's public Instagram, used with his agreement (said by Dinis Cruz, 25 November 2026). Cropped to remove the app controls.

interview.title: Where you coach
questions: Do you coach at one place or several? Please name them.
Are you happy for the site to say where you coach, and may it name the club?
Do you travel to coach, or coach at private courts?

interview.title: Levels and groups
questions: Who do you coach: beginners, improvers, advanced players, juniors, adults?
Do you offer one-to-one, pairs, small groups, or all of these?
Do you run clinics, camps or classes? How would you describe each?

interview.title: Padel performance and personal training
questions: What does a padel performance session involve, in your own words?
What does personal training with you involve, and who is it for?
Do you combine court and gym work for the same person?

interview.title: Prices and booking
questions: Do you want prices on the site, or only on request?
How do you want people to book: message you, a booking page, through a club?
Do you want to take payments through the site, or not?

interview.title: Online and remote
questions: Would you like to offer anything online, such as video-call lessons, video feedback on someone's recorded match, or a remote training plan?
Would you record short drill or fitness videos for the site, and who would appear in them?
If you offer online sessions, how should people book and pay: a link to a booking page, or a message to you?
Is there anything you would not want to do online?

interview.title: Availability
questions: Which days and times do you usually coach?
Should the site show a timetable, or just say "message to ask"?

interview.title: Achievements and qualifications
questions: Which coaching qualifications do you hold? Please give each exact name.
Are there results, rankings or playing history you want mentioned?
Is there anything you do not want mentioned?

interview.title: Fundraising
questions: What fundraising have you done, and for which cause?
Do you want a page for it, and a link where people can give?
Who should be thanked by name, and have they agreed?

interview.title: Photos and video
questions: Which photos and videos do you want on the site?
Has everyone who appears in them agreed to be on your site?
Should any club names or logos in the pictures be cropped out?
Your Instagram has Food, Gym and Fundraising highlights. Do you want a page for any of them?

interview.title: Your name and how people reach you
questions: Do you want your full name on the site?
Which contact method do you want: Instagram messages, WhatsApp, email, phone?
Is there a line or short story about you that you would like at the top of the home page?
